description: Gateway-integrated API for customer apps. Authenticate with a forwarded customer session (Gasket auth), a developer portal API key (`Authorization: sso-key` on the public gateway URL), or an OAuth Bearer access token. When using Bearer auth, each operation requires the OAuth scope listed on that operation. API keys do not use OAuth scopes. After publish or domain changes, poll GET …/deployments and GET …/status. After zip upload, poll GET …/source/status with the returned jobId.
